station_name: Rodriguez Reservoir at Rodriguez Dam, Baja California, Mex.
notes: Heading number "132." is the report's own station numbering, not put in station_number. Also printed: on Rio de las Palmas, a quarter of a mile upstream from Arroyo Matanuco and 10 miles southeast of Tijuana. Counted 13 month-end contents (Sept. 30 1958 through Sept. 30 1959; first row is the last day of the previous water year). Summary values: 12 monthly changes in contents + calendar year 1958 + water year 1958-59 changes = 14. Title says water year October 1958 to September 1959. Site is in Mexico, no U.S. state for the site.
